title: NVlabs/GR00T-WholeBodyControl
abstract:
Welcome to GR00T Whole-Body Control (WBC)! This is a unified platform for developing and deploying advanced humanoid controllers. This includes: Decoupled WBC models used in NVIDIA Isaac-Gr00t, Gr00t N1.5 and N1.6 and GEAR-SONIC

[ ](LICENSE) [ ](https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacLab/releases/tag/v2.3.2) [ ](https://nvlabs.github.io/GR00T-WholeBodyControl/) [ ](https://nvlabs.github.io/GEAR-SONIC/demo.html) --- # GR00T-WholeBodyControl This is the codebase for the **GR00T Whole-Body Control (WBC)** projects. It hosts model checkpoints and scripts for training, evaluating, and deploying advanced whole-body controllers for humanoid robots. We currently support: - **Decoupled WBC**: the decoupled controller (RL for lower body, and IK for upper body) used in NVIDIA GR00T [N1.5](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/gr00t-n1_5/) and [N1.6](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/gr00t-n1_6/) models; - **GEAR-SONIC Series**: our latest iteration of generalist humanoid whole-body controllers (see our [whitepaper](https://nvlabs.github.io/GEAR-SONIC/)); - **MotionBricks**: a real-time latent generative model for interactive motion control in animation and robotics (see the [project page](https://nvlabs.github.io/motionbricks/)). ## News - **[2026-08-31]** **SONIC deployment update** — added per-motor Kp/Kd scaling to reduce stumbling. - **[2026-07-23]** **SONIC v1.1 checkpoint** — released a robot-heading-normalized SONIC controller trained with wrist-pose augmentation for whole-body teleoperation and SONIC-backed VLA execution. See the [Model Card](#model-card) and [Download Models](https://nvlabs.github.io/GR00T-WholeBodyControl/getting_started/download_models.html#sonic-v11-checkpoint). - **[06/16]** **Isaac Teleop Setup (CloudXR / DeviceIO, in-process)** — added bring-up docs for the in-process CloudXR path via `isaacteleop[cloudxr]`, with no separate publisher container. See [Isaac Teleop Setup](https://nvlabs.github.io/GR00T-WholeBodyControl/tutorials/isaac_teleop_publisher_setup.html). - **[2026-06-16]** **Low-latency teleoperation checkpoint** — released a SONIC checkpoint with 4-frame SMPL reference lookahead for more responsive whole-body teleoperation. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：开源统一代码库，托管三类全身控制器：解耦式 WBC（下肢 RL + 上肢 IK，服务于 GR00T N1.5/N1.6）、通用人形全身控制器 GEAR-SONIC 系列，以及用于动画与机器人交互式运动控制的实时隐生成模型 MotionBricks，并提供 checkpoints 与训练/评估/部署脚本。


# 一、动机

> 人形机器人全身控制器（WBC）此前多为零散项目，缺少统一的训练、评估与真机部署平台，且上下肢控制解耦、通用性与实时响应性难以兼顾。


# 二、方法

> 开源统一代码库，托管三类全身控制器：解耦式 WBC（下肢 RL + 上肢 IK，服务于 GR00T N1.5/N1.6）、通用人形全身控制器 GEAR-SONIC 系列，以及用于动画与机器人交互式运动控制的实时隐生成模型 MotionBricks，并提供 checkpoints 与训练/评估/部署脚本。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 1) SONIC v1.1 checkpoint 发布，为机器人朝向归一化控制器，配合手腕位姿增强，支持全身遥操作与 SONIC 驱动的 VLA 执行；2) 低延迟遥操作 checkpoint 采用 4 帧 SMPL 参考前瞻（lookahead），显著提升全身遥操作响应性；3) 部署侧加入 per-motor Kp/Kd 缩放以降低绊倒（stumbling）问题；另有 in-process CloudXR/DeviceIO 遥操作接入方案，无需独立 publisher 容器。


# 四、对我的启发

> 工作偏工程与系统集成，摘要未给出定量性能指标（成功率、跟踪误差、延迟毫秒数等），难以直接横向比较；但其『解耦 WBC + 通用控制器 + 生成式运动先验』的组合路线，以及面向 VLA 执行与遥操作的部署接口，对具身智能中『下层控制器如何服务上层大模型』这一问题有参考价值。
